summary: No repository table pairing individual-level trait or genomic-diversity measurements of domestic varieties with their wild progenitors was found; EVA holds raw variants for domestic species and DAD-IS lists breeds, but within-breed variance versus wild variance has to be compiled from individual studies.
next_step: Choose a pre-registered set of matched pairs (e.g. dog/wolf, chicken/red junglefowl, maize/teosinte), pull population variant sets from EVA/NCBI or published supplements, and decide the trait set and standardisation before computing variance.
obstacles_confirmed: Modern breed standards and inbred lines deliberately reduce within-breed variance, so contemporary data may not reflect the nineteenth-century contrast.
Genesys characterisation data were not accessible without credentials (401).
Four Dryad/DataCite searches for domestic-vs-wild variance comparisons returned no relevant dataset.
